title: One melody, two records
pending: Needs the shared melody as notes from a sourced transcription before it can play (Q30). The two tempos in params were written in M1 and are unverified.

params.melody: the shared melodic contour, played on synthesized voices, not sampled from either record

caption: The notes do not change. What changes is speed, the sharpness of the sound, and what the drums are doing, and that is most of what made the second record feel new. This is synthesized on purpose rather than sampled: pulling the melody away from both recordings shows how one was built from the other better than either record could.
